title: Deploying updates without killing live users? Here's the trick
caption: Zero-downtime deployments demystified. What is your go-to rollback strategy?

scenes.vo: Updating live software without taking your entire site down sounds impossible. Kubernetes solves this with Rolling Updates.
scenes.heading: ROLLING UPDATES

scenes.vo: Think of changing racecar tires one by one during a pit stop, so the car never touches bare ground.
scenes.heading: THE ANALOGY

scenes.vo: Kubernetes spins up a new pod first, waits for health checks, and then safely deletes an old pod.
scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS

scenes.vo: If your new version crashes immediately, Kubernetes pauses the rollout, keeping your users safe on working pods.
scenes.heading: BAD RELEASE?

scenes.vo: To recover instantly, you do not rewrite YAML. One kubectl command rolls back to your last revision.
scenes.heading: INSTANT FIX

scenes.vo: Rolling updates deliver zero downtime, automatic safety, and instant rollbacks. Follow for more Kubernetes made simple!
scenes.heading: ROLLING UPDATES
